text:
sarah: Heads up — we're getting a sharp 5xx spike on hosted inference after the canary flip. Customer tickets inbound. Gateway 502/504s, increased latency, and retries. Anyone oncall?
ryan-oncall: I'm here. Can you paste the logs and which flag/deploy was changed?
sarah: Flag flipped: experimental-kvroute=true at ~2024-06-15T10:07Z (canary). Brief log snippet:
```
2024-06-15T10:12:23Z ERROR gateway: upstream 502 for /v1/generate svc=api-gateway req_id=tx-9f3a
2024-06-15T10:12:24Z WARN orch: missing route config for tenant=acct-42 header=x-orch-config:null
2024-06-15T10:12:25Z ERROR infer: kvcache miss + fallback failed status=502
```
maya: That flag toggles the new KV-based routing selector. My rollout increased canary weight from 10%->40% at ~10:12. Could be selector overmatching. I'll look at routing table.
ryan-oncall: @deploy-bot can you show recent deploy/rollout and flag changes for kvroute?
deploy-bot: deployment kvroute-v2 started by @maya at 2024-06-15T10:07Z. Canary traffic: 10% -> 40% at 2024-06-15T10:12Z. Config change id cfg-20240615-09. No automatic rollback triggered.
luis-support: Customer A reported 502s starting 10:18Z, multiple retries causing billing spikes and error alerts. They've asked for an ETA. We should rollback or flip the flag immediately.
maya: I think we should flip the feature flag off rather than full code rollback — the selector appears to have leaked scope to more tenants. The flag change may have been applied at the wrong authority (global not region-scoped).
tess-eng-sre: I can flip it. Plan: 1) set experimental-kvroute=false in config service for canary regions 2) add a temporary routing fallback rule to force classic routing on gateway 3) scale canary pods down if rollback doesn't drop errors. Who's approving?
ryan-oncall: Approve. Also create a short traffic rule: if upstream returns 502, route to classic model variant until config stable.
tess-eng-sre: Executing now.
```bash
# flip flag for canary scope
curl -XPOST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/flags/experimental-kvroute 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
 -d '{"value":false,"scope":"canary"}'
```
tess-eng-sre: Flag flip done at 2024-06-15T10:24:08Z. Pushed fallback routing rule to gateway. Scaling canary replica set down by 50% for safety.
deploy-bot: config cfg-20240615-09 rolled back (flag experimental-kvroute=false) by tess-eng-sre at 2024-06-15T10:24:08Z. Canary replicas scaled from 8 -> 4.
maya: Monitoring telemetry now — 5xx rate was 8.2% pre-flip, dropped to 0.6% within ~3m after rollback. Latency returning to baseline.
luis-support: Notifying Customer A: we rolled back the config that caused the routing change and will issue a billing credit for the retry window.
ryan-oncall: Action items: 1) postmortem with timeline and root cause (probable global-scope flag write + selector overmatch) 2) add guard in config service to prevent unscoped flips for infra flags 3) tighten canary selector tests (negative matching) 4) add automatic short-circuit fallback when upstream 502 surge detected.
sarah: I'll collect traces + sample request ids and attach to the postmortem. Example trace id: trace-abc123 (shows kvroute selection step failing).
maya: I'll open the PR to add a config-authority check and add unit tests for selector specificity.
tess-eng-sre: Logged runbook step to flip flag and fallback rule under incident playbook. Will hand off to eng-sre for follow-up.
luis-support: Customer comms drafted and sent. Refund approved for the spike window.
sarah: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: when blocked items are in motion.
ryan-oncall: :thumbsup:
